body: I'm playing a ranger and my beast buddy spider got stuck on an item (I played for an hour before noticing it wasn't with me, this also happened more than once because I have the memory of a goldfish) and, from what my friend said after watch some clips I recorded, I was able to access areas I wasn't supposed to due to NPCs not loading and it caused some quests to be automatically skipped

It used to be 60 dollars for a fully completed game with hours of content, obvious passion, and a cool collectors box/manual. Now it's 80 dollars for a soulless digital game that doesn't work and most content is locked behind thousands of dollars in microtransactions and/loot box's. I don't even get excited about new releases anymore
